import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        long t = 1;
        while (t-- > 0) {
            go(scanner);
        }
        scanner.close();
    }
    
    static void go(Scanner scanner) {
        long n = scanner.nextLong();
        long[] a = new long[(int)n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = scanner.nextLong();
        }
        Arrays.sort(a);
        System.out.println(a[(int)(n / 2)]);
    }
}
